answer: Require earned-history staking: an agent gains voting or payout weight only after completing verifiable jobs for many unrelated counterparties, each recorded on-ledger. A flood of fresh fake identities breaks like a gale against a wall, because new accounts start at zero weight and cannot buy a past. Attackers who trade only with themselves leave a visible spiral of circular transactions that auditors can flag and discount. Genuine reputation then hardens like crystal: slow to form, hard to counterfeit, and easy for anyone to check before trusting an agent.
